Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a price of €370.96 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, no Preisgleitklausel. 

Regarding our cost structure, CU-NOTATION rose 47.7 % in twelve months and is 20 % of our cost. LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 20 % of our cost. PPI-C241 rose 6.5 % in twelve months and is 14 % of our cost.

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Petra Lechner
Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG

move.subject: Re: Quote from Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG: Nordmark passes on copper for the 7.5 kW motor
move.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your offer and for the time your team has put into it.
We understand that the sharp rise in copper costs is putting pressure on your pricing, and appreciate the cost breakdown. Our fixed order volume covers our full demand for this part over the term, all with Nordmark, and our forecast is rising; could you review the proposed terms with your pricing committee in light of this?

Our last 3 orders for this part were at EUR 348.32 (po:4500014474-10, po:4500014413-10, po:4500014350-20).
Our forecast for this part is up 11.9% (fc:350011@2026-09).

On this basis we propose: EUR 351.23 per unit, payment 90 days net, fixed price, for our full demand of 6110 units a year over 12 months.

Could you share your cost breakdown for this part, so we understand the drivers together?

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

move.text:
Dear Sir or Madam,
Thank you for your e-mail, which we have reviewed internally.
We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.
Our terms: a price of €373.13 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, no Preisgleitklausel.
For your information:
We checked the price history data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation.
We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account.
To support this price reduction, we must maintain our standard payment terms of 30 days net, as an extension to 90 days would incur additional costs.
The primary cost drivers remain as detailed in our initial offer, specifically the significant increase in copper indices.
Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 30 days net: €369.02 per unit.
A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price.
Which volume can you commit to?
Our calculation is our property; we do not share a breakdown.
This offer is subject to our general terms of sale.
Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Petra Lechner
Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG

move.subject: Re: Quote from Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG: Nordmark passes on copper for the 7.5 kW motor
move.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your reply and for the step you have taken; we appreciate it.
Thank you for moving your offer and for explaining the impact of copper costs and payment terms; we appreciate your efforts, especially given the formal approvals required for larger price steps. Our order volume is fixed at our full demand for this part over the term, all with Nordmark, and our forecast is rising, but we cannot commit to a higher volume. Our proposal moves further toward you, with all terms set out below.

On this basis we propose: EUR 367.53 per unit, payment 90 days net, fixed price, for our full demand of 6110 units a year over 12 months.

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing
